rationale: The stock is trading at the absolute bottom of its daily range (1.2% position) with high relative volume (10x) following a significant gap-down, indicating strong selling pressure and a lack of immediate buying interest to support a long entry. While a short entry is mechanically possible given the downtrend, entering at the session low offers a poor risk-reward ratio due to the proximity of the invalidation level and the potential for a mean-reversion bounce off the lows.
